text: I was hurt in a car accident in Perth. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

sections.text:
If you were injured in a Perth car accident, contact **two or three WA personal-injury firms for initial case assessments** and compare their experience, fees, and approach. Potential options include:

- **Maurice Blackburn** — Perth road-injury team; handles claims through WA’s Motor Injury Insurance Scheme. Phone: **(08) 6220 4300**.[1]
- **Turner Freeman** — motor-vehicle injury specialists offering no-win-no-fee arrangements subject to conditions. Perth office: **(08) 9325 0900** or **13 43 63**.[3][4]
- **Foyle Legal** — WA-focused motor-vehicle accident practice handling ICWA claims. Phone: **1300 300 966**.[5]
- **Bradford Legal** — Perth motor-accident compensation lawyers offering a free appointment. Phone: **(08) 9316 2299**.[6]
- **Perth City Legal** — handles motor-vehicle and other personal-injury claims. Phone: **(08) 9486 8088**.[7]
- **Withstand Lawyers** — handles WA car-accident claims under the ICWA scheme and advertises a free claim check. Phone: **1800 952 898**.[8]

In WA, a fault-based compulsory third-party claim is generally managed through the **Insurance Commission of Western Australia (ICWA)**, and compensation may include medical expenses, lost income, and—depending on the injury—pain and suffering.[1][5][8]

When calling, ask:

- Whether they regularly handle **WA motor-injury/ICWA claims**
- Whether your claim is **no win, no fee**, and exactly what deductions or “uplift” fees apply
- Who will personally run the case and whether barrister, medical, and disbursement costs are covered
- Applicable claim deadlines and what evidence you should preserve

Seek medical attention promptly, report the accident as required, keep medical and wage-loss records, and avoid giving a recorded statement or accepting a settlement before obtaining legal advice. If there was a fatality, serious injury, disputed fault, or you were partly at fault, obtain advice urgently.
